system_name: 12C AI-Based Medical Travel Decision Support System
integrity_pledge: All metrics are derived strictly from genuine existing models, datasets, and benchmarks without synthetic or reverse-engineered ground truth. Unmeasurable metrics are explicitly reported as NOT MEASURABLE.

ocr_and_clinical_ner.ner_token_level_f1_reason: No independent gold-standard clinical token annotation corpus (e.g. NCBI-Disease or i2b2) is bundled in the repository. Reporting F1 would require synthesizing artificial labels, violating research integrity.
ocr_and_clinical_ner.ocr_full_wer_scanned_image_reason: A complete manual word-by-word gold-truth transcription for 1.webp was not provided. Key-term anchor detection (5/5 anchors matched) is reported instead.
ocr_and_clinical_ner.limitations: Evaluated on project-available sample documents and benchmark clinical test phrases.

rag_retrieval_and_grounding.limitations: Evaluated against 18 curated international clinical guidelines (ESC, ACC, AAOS, AANS, ASCO).

recommendation_engine.limitations: Evaluated against seeded healthcare provider database of 55+ accredited hospitals.

dataset_provenance.calibration_source: National Health Authority (NHA / PMJAY) standard package tariffs & GIPSA schedule of charges
dataset_provenance.disclosure: The 2,500 patient episodes in Dataset 4 are synthetic benchmark data generated for decision-support algorithm testing. High benchmark performance metrics reflect the synthetic data-generation process and do not establish real-world clinical validity.

cost_and_los_prediction.limitations: 2,500 patient episodes are SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK DATA generated for this project, calibrated using publicly available NHA/PMJAY standard package tariffs and GIPSA schedules. They do not represent real electronic medical records or hospital billing data.

navigation_and_travel.limitations: Modeled as a connected planar graph of key medical transit nodes; not live GPS telemetry.

assistant_safety_and_grounding.emergency_advisory_standard: Advises local emergency services; presents 112/108 as configured demo contacts
assistant_safety_and_grounding.cross_user_isolation_defense: 100% (Enforced at FastAPI router layer via HTTP 403 Forbidden)
assistant_safety_and_grounding.limitations: Safety rules evaluated against benchmark clinical safety prompts; non-emergency clinical answers require verified RAG evidence.

e2e_workflow_steps_evaluated: 2. Medical Document Upload & Hybrid OCR Parsing
3. BioClinicalBERT Named Entity Extraction & Specialty Prediction
4. RAG-Grounded Medical Report Analysis & Guideline Retrieval
6. XGBoost Treatment Cost & LOS ML Estimation + TreeSHAP Explanation
12. Strict Cross-Patient Vault Isolation & IDOR Defense
e2e_workflow_reliability.limitations: Evaluated using FastAPI TestClient automated test execution on SQLite test instance.

gap_1_unstructured_reports.gap: Unstructured multimodal medical report parsing with specialized clinical entities
gap_1_unstructured_reports.objective: Objective 1: Automated extraction of clinical diagnostics, symptoms, medications, and findings via Hybrid OCR + BioClinicalBERT
gap_1_unstructured_reports.status: VALIDATED WITH HONEST LIMITATIONS (NER Token F1 unmeasurable without annotated gold corpus; digital token recall 100%, content-driven specialty acc 100%)

gap_2_llm_hallucination.gap: Hallucination and lack of verifiable clinical guideline grounding in medical LLMs
gap_2_llm_hallucination.objective: Objective 2: Evidence-grounded retrieval-augmented generation with verified clinical citations and safety refusals
gap_2_llm_hallucination.status: VALIDATED (Recall@1 100%, Recall@3 100%, MRR 1.0, 100% verified citation coverage on benchmark guidelines)

gap_3_fragmented_search.gap: Fragmented single-factor searches lacking multi-attribute optimization across clinical, cost, and logistics criteria
gap_3_fragmented_search.objective: Objective 3: Multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) weighted recommendation scoring across 6 attributes
gap_3_fragmented_search.status: VALIDATED (Specialty alignment @ Top-1 100%, budget compliance 100% on benchmark profiles)

gap_4_pricing_and_stay_opacity.gap: Opaque healthcare procedure pricing and unpredictable hospitalization stay duration
gap_4_pricing_and_stay_opacity.objective: Objective 4: Interpretable machine learning regressions (XGBoost) for procedure cost and hospitalization LOS with TreeSHAP explanations
gap_4_pricing_and_stay_opacity.status: VALIDATED (Cost R² 0.9689, MAE ₹24,307; LOS R² 0.8545, MAE 0.716 days on held-out N=375 test split; explicit synthetic benchmark provenance disclosed)

gap_5_spatial_logistics_disconnect.gap: Disconnect between surgical hospital scheduling, recovery accommodation, and spatial transit logistics
gap_5_spatial_logistics_disconnect.objective: Objective 5: Graph-based A* pathfinding and recovery stay matching tailored to patient mobility
gap_5_spatial_logistics_disconnect.status: VALIDATED (100% route reachability, 100% heuristic admissibility, sub-millisecond graph search)

gap_6_safety_and_data_isolation.gap: Cross-patient data leakage, safety non-compliance, and fragile disconnected patient journeys
gap_6_safety_and_data_isolation.objective: Objective 6: Safe conversational guardrails, strict cross-user vault isolation, and reliable end-to-end workflow execution
gap_6_safety_and_data_isolation.status: VALIDATED (100% emergency advisory compliance, 100% cross-user IDOR rejection, 100% multi-stage workflow pass rate across 95 regression tests)
